patients with schizophrenia exhibit abnormalities in the cortico-cereal-striatal-thalamo-cortical loop and in task-positive and tasknegative cortical networks.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

schizophrenia is characterized by a generalized deficit in the intrinsic communication within and between the cortico-cortical, cortico-striatal, and cerebellar systems that are involved in cognitive processes.
the observed functional connectivity abnormalities in schizophrenia are related to a generalized cognitive deficit, and are not specific to particular cognitive domains.
the observed abnormalities in the functional connectome in schizophrenia are related to a generalized cognitive deficit, and are not related to a specific cognitive deficit.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cortico-cortical and cortico-subcortical functional systems that we reviewed may be the neural substrate for cognitive deficits in schizophrenia.
the cognitive deficits in schizophrenia may be due to the disruption of a set of functional networks that support a variety of cognitive abilities.

the current literature on the relationship between rs-fcMRI and cognition in schizophrenia is limited by the small sample sizes, lack of replication, and the lack of consistency in the definition of cognitive constructs.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the cognitive deficits found in schizophrenia may result from a breakdown in the communication between specific functional networks that support cognition, and that future research in this area will be important for understanding the cognitive deficits found within schizophrenia.

the functional systems that have been identified through resting-state fMRI studies may underlie mechanisms shared across cognitive domains, the disturbance of these mechanisms may be a source of the generalized cognitive deficit found in patients with schizophrenia, and the study of the functional systems may help elucidate neurobiological sources of this deficit.
the cognitive deficits in schizophrenia may arise from abnormal intrinsic communication within and between the functional brain systems that support cognition.
